title: Neon Dash
core_loop: Player controls a glowing cube that automatically moves forward through a procedurally generated tunnel. Dodge obstacles by moving left/right or jumping while collecting score pickups. Each second survived increases your score multiplier. Death resets the run and displays your final score.
controls: A/D or Left/Right Arrow keys to move horizontally between three lanes. Spacebar or W/Up Arrow to jump. Touch/click on left/right thirds of screen for mobile lane switching, tap center to jump.
mechanics: Three-lane horizontal movement system (left, center, right lanes)
Jump mechanic to vault over low obstacles
Continuous forward movement with gradual speed increase over time
Procedural obstacle generation with increasing density
Score pickups (glowing orbs) that add to multiplier
Score multiplier that increases every 5 seconds survived (1x -> 2x -> 3x, etc.)
One-hit death system with instant game over
juice: Pulsing neon glow effects on player cube and obstacles using canvas shadows
Particle burst when collecting score orbs (radiating lines)
Screen shake on collision with brief slow-motion effect
Smooth camera follow with slight anticipation
Color shift of tunnel walls as speed increases (blue -> purple -> red)
Trail effect behind player cube that intensifies with multiplier
Floating score popup animations when collecting orbs
Death explosion with geometric fragments scattering
Subtle scanline/CRT effect overlay for retro aesthetic
Pulsing multiplier indicator in corner that grows with combo
mvp_scope: Single endless tunnel environment with wireframe/geometric aesthetic. Three obstacle types: barriers blocking single lanes, low hurdles requiring jumps, and floating walls requiring specific lane positioning. Procedural generation spawns obstacles at increasing frequency. All graphics use HTML5 Canvas with geometric shapes, gradients, and glow effects. No external assets. Score display, game over screen with restart button, and high score persistence. Responsive design supporting both keyboard and touch input. Target 60fps performance.
win_lose_condition: There is no win condition - this is an endless high-score challenge. Lose condition: Colliding with any obstacle instantly ends the run. Goal is to survive as long as possible and achieve the highest score through survival time and collecting orbs with active multipliers.
